Discard columns having specific modalities

Source: R/factor.R
discard_col_w_levels.Rd

Discard columns having a specific set of levels

Usage

discard_col_w_levels(
  data,
  levels,
  ignore_case = FALSE,
  id_cols = NULL,
  fun = c("all", "any")
)

Arguments

data

entry dataset

levels

complete set of specific levels seeked for the variables

ignore_case

Should case differences be ignored in the match? For fixed(), this uses a simple algorithm which assumes a one-to-one mapping between upper and lower case letters.

id_cols

A set of columns that uniquely identify each observation. Typically used when you have to detect rows that don't behave as expected.

fun

matching function used to match the levels seeked.

Value

A selection of columns from the input dataset that have no other levels than the ones specified in the levels argument

Examples

# Discard dummy columns
data.frame(
 num = c(1, 2),
 dummy = c(1, 0),
 char = c("a", NA_character_),
 factor = c("non", "oui"),
 na_col = rep(NA_real_, times = 2)
) %>%
 discard_col_w_levels(levels = c("non", "oui"))
#>   num dummy char
#> 1   1     1    a
#> 2   2     0 <NA>
